title: Sunny room in Yaba flat
description: Private room in a calm 3-bedroom shared with two working professionals. In-unit washer, borehole water, and a prepaid meter. Quiet after 10pm on weeknights.

title: Room near UNILAG with balcony
description: Furnished room, 10 minutes from the university gate. Shared kitchen and sitting room, cleaning rota on the fridge. Looking for a tidy student or corps member.

title: Ensuite room in Lekki Phase 1
description: Spacious ensuite room in a serviced estate. 24-hour power, security, and parking for one car. Ideal for a remote worker — fibre internet already installed.

title: Cozy room in Surulere
description: Room in a friendly 2-bedroom close to Adeniran Ogunsanya. Shared bills split evenly, guests fine on weekends with a heads-up.

title: Quiet room in Gbagada estate
description: Neat room facing the courtyard — no road noise. Estate with good water and a small gym nearby. No smoking indoors.

title: Room in Ikeja GRA duplex
description: Large room with wardrobe wall in a shared duplex. Boys-quarters kitchen access, POP ceilings, and a standby generator.

title: Affordable room in Ajah
description: Simple clean room near the Ajah bridge. Shared kitchen, prepaid meter, danfo and BRT nearby. First month plus agreement fee.

title: Victoria Island studio share
description: Half of a large studio on Ahmadu Bello Way — partitioned sleeping areas, shared bath and kitchenette. Great for a young banker or analyst.

title: Room in Maryland family flat
description: One room in a 3-bedroom family flat; the family travels often so it is mostly quiet. Separate entrance, shared kitchen.

title: Ogudu waterfront room
description: Airy room overlooking the water in Ogudu. Work-from-home friendly, backup inverter, and a housemate who cooks on Sundays.
